preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 2 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct strings that can be obtained after performing exactly one swap.
